comments.text:
There are so many mistakes in this video that I do not know where to start.
First, the map of the republic of Dubrovnik is totally wrong. The republic of Dubrovnik stretched from Neum towards the south and never controled the entire coast as shown in the video.
It is not possible to make a port in the bay of Neum because it is too shallow. To make a cruise ship terminal is hilarious because there is nothing there to see, except for a few hundred houses and a few hotels.
The area of Neum and all of western Herzegovina is and has ALWAYS been inhabbited with 95% CROAT population. The borders were drawn by big powers centuries ago, and not by ethnic lines.
The Croat and Serbian population in Bosnia identifies as Croat or Serb. Only the muslim population, former Christians that changed their religion (to avoid high  taxes enforced on catholics) during the Ottoman occupation which lasted about 450 years nowadays call themselves Bosniaks. Bosnian is not a nationality, rather a geographical term such as a Croat from the regions of Dalmatia,Slavonia or Istria. Serbs from Morava, Vojvodina etc.
